name: WizardOS Tracker
short_desc: The WizardOS team's build line: goals, features and bugs on GitHub. Install, sign in with GitHub, done.
author: Humanity Labs
description: The WizardOS team's tracker: goals, core and app features and bugs across humanitylabs-org, each moving Queued → Building → AI review → Human review → Done, with the builder switch, Try it switches and Works / Doesn't work for reviews. Open it and tap Sign in with GitHub: approve the short code on github.com and you're in. For WizardOS team members (your own GitHub account; agents use the Tracker's tools). When a new version is out, the Tracker shows an Update button on its main screen.
